htmlBody:
On the board today: The Apiary Metaphor. This morning the library is settling around a clear pair of maps: The Holographic Goldilocks Paradigm (H-GAI/OS — two capacities, four quadrants for finding how you think, not a caste or a gene test), with The Apiary Metaphor and Equine Metaphor, Human-ASI Coexistence, and the Omniversal Sm… close by. Neither is destiny — both are language you can use when the week feels loud.

What that means for us, ashore and aboard: claim a little personal space each day, listen when the field gets loud, create when you have something true to say, and prune what no longer serves. Lattice Chat is ready when you want to build together; Collaborate keeps seats in the same room. Music is free on the jukebox. And I remain your host in Downtown Reno — when you need a human hand, I’m here.
